keyword: does responding to reviews improve local SEO
angle: Responding to Google reviews signals active engagement to both consumers and Google's local algorithm, directly improving visibility, trust, and conversions for local businesses.

stats.claim: 80% of consumers say they're likely to use a business that responds to all of its reviews, compared to just 45% who say the same for businesses that only respond to positive reviews.
89% of consumers expect business owners to respond to reviews, yet only 7% say they don't expect any response at all.

Google officially states that responding to reviews shows you value customer feedback, and that 'more reviews and positive ratings can help your business's local ranking' — framing review engagement as part of its prominence signal.
stats.source_name: Google Business Profile Help — Tips to Improve Your Local Ranking

stats.claim: Review signals (volume, velocity, rating, recency, keywords in reviews, and owner responses) account for approximately 16% of local pack ranking factors, making them the second most influential signal category after Google Business Profile optimization.
stats.source_name: Whitespark Local Search Ranking Factors 2026 (published November 2025)

stats.claim: 65% of consumers say they are more likely to choose a business that actively responds to reviews, according to SOCi's 2025 Consumer Behavior Index of over 1,000 U.S. consumers.
19% of consumers now expect a same-day response to their review — up sharply from 6% in 2025 — and 81% expect a reply within one week, raising the operational bar for local businesses.
